items.name: Power Management Workflow Overview
items.description: Readback-only helper that explains the safe workflow: snapshot first, apply one change, then verify with powercfg query commands.

steps.command: Write-Output "Power Management flow: 1) Snapshot plan 2) Apply scoped change 3) Verify with powercfg /query or /qh."

items.name: Export: All Settings Explorer Snapshot (/qh + aliases)
items.description: Exports aliases and /qh output so you can inspect real power setting values (diagnostic export, not an optimization).

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null}; powercfg /aliases | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ("power-aliases-"+$ts+".txt")); powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 (Join-Path $dir ("power-qh-"+$ts+".txt")); Write-Output "Saved power snapshots to logs/."

items.name: Refresh Active Scheme (readback helper)
items.description: Re-applies the active scheme and prints it for verification (readback helper, not an optimization).
